nfr.statement: How long replaced and deleted designs, and their files, are kept.
nfr.open_question: Designs are soft-deleted and replaced designs are kept; is there a retention or purge period for them and their files?

requirements.title: Replacing a design with a revision
requirements.statement: A user replaces a design by uploading a new file that names the design it replaces. Once the upload completes the old design is marked replaced. When the new design becomes active, the old one becomes inactive and the new one takes over as capture sheet if the old one was. A design that is still processing can't be replaced.
requirements.rationale: Whether takeoff and progress should keep carrying forward to the revision is open (PROG-REQ-006, DEC-003). This requirement covers only the design records.

acceptance_criteria.then: A is inactive and replaced, and B is the floor's capture sheet

acceptance_criteria.given: A sheet that is still processing
acceptance_criteria.when: An admin asks to replace it

requirements.title: Revisions from a linked Autodesk folder are imported automatically
requirements.statement: When a new version of a linked Autodesk file is published, each linked design that isn't inactive gets a new revision: same location, type and uploader, version number one higher, in the same revision line. The old design is marked replaced, the new one starts processing, and the uploader is emailed.
requirements.rationale: Integration set-up (linking folders, Procore) belongs to INTG; this covers the revision effect on designs.

requirements.title: Which designs can be deleted
requirements.statement: Deleting a design hides it rather than erasing it. The capture sheet and any architectural sheet can't be deleted, nor can a design whose sheet type an asset category uses on that location. The Track3D team is emailed about each deletion.
